PERSONAL_INFO.TITLE: About me...
PERSONAL_INFO.TEXT_P1: I am Hergen Engelhardt and bring diverse professional experience from the hotel industry, customer service, sales, as well as logistics and purchasing. These roles have significantly shaped my organizational talent, communication skills, and solution-oriented approach.
PERSONAL_INFO.TEXT_P2: By successfully completing further training as a frontend developer, I have laid the foundation for my career in IT. I am currently deepening my knowledge in the backend area. I work with modern technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, Firebase, Git, and Scrum – always striving to write clean and user-friendly code.
PERSONAL_INFO.TEXT_P3: Alongside my professional development, I volunteer with the local fire department and am a passionate traveler – always curious about new places, cultures, and culinary discoveries.

SKILLS.TITLE: My Skills...
SKILLS.TEXT_P1: I develop modern web applications using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, specifically utilizing TypeScript and Angular to create high-performance and scalable solutions. UX and design are important to me – that's why I enjoy working with Figma to design user-friendly interfaces.
SKILLS.TEXT_P2: For data storage and hosting, I use Firebase, while Git ensures structured version control. Agile methods like Scrum allow me to react flexibly to new requirements and work efficiently in a team.
SKILLS.TEXT_P3: I have gained initial practical experience through projects such as: – a delivery app – a Pokédex with search functionality – a Kanban board – my own 2D game. These projects have shown me how much joy the combination of creative thinking and technical implementation brings – and how much potential lies in every new development step.
